scripts.health-check:sdk: OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:2890/v1 OPENAI_API_KEY=chatgpt-oauth-placeholder uv run python examples/sdk.py
scripts.health-check:langgraph: OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:2890/v1 OPENAI_API_KEY=chatgpt-oauth-placeholder uv run python examples/langgraph.py
scripts.infra:ps: uv run python proxy-server/health_check.py && docker compose ps
scripts.test:unit: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.clean: rm -rf .venv .pytest_cache .mypy_cache .ruff_cache htmlcov .coverage && find core proxy-server examples tests -type d -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
